svg.title: Example Platform (fictional) · One admission record, end to end
svg.desc: Journey “One admission record, end to end” over the components of Example Platform (fictional).

g.aria-label: Sources: Where does the data come from?
Ingestion: How does data get into the platform?
Storage: Where is it kept, and in what format?
Processing and transformation: What engine cleans, joins and prepares it?
Consumption: How does it reach dashboards, reports and apps?
Artificial intelligence: How are models and agents built on the data?
Admissions system. System outside the platform. Generally available. Step 1: The record is born.
Relational database connector. Data ingestion and integration. Generally available.
Change capture. Data ingestion and integration. Generally available. Step 2: The change is detected.
Raw data zone. Storage and open formats. Generally available. Step 3: Stored as is.
Clean tables in an open format. Storage and open formats. Generally available. Step 5: Ready to be used.
Transformation engine. Transformation and orchestration. Generally available. Step 4: Cleaned and combined.
Declarative pipelines. Transformation and orchestration. Generally available.
Semantic model. Analytics and business intelligence. Generally available. Step 6a: Becomes an indicator.
Bed occupancy dashboard. Analytics and business intelligence. Generally available. Step 7a: Shows on the dashboard.
Data question agent. AI and agents on the data. Public preview. Step 6b: Serves as context for an agent.
Governance and security: Who can see what, and how is it audited?

text.tspan: Who can see what, and how is

g.aria-label: Central catalog. Governance, security and lineage. Generally available.
Row filters and masking. Governance, security and lineage. Generally available.

Operations and cost: How is it monitored, deployed and paid for?
Usage monitor. Operations, monitoring and cost. Generally available.

Task scheduler. Transformation and orchestration. Generally available.
